onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before pausing/unpausing.
onlyOwner modifier gates rainCheckSetBaseURI on msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates rainCheckSetDelegate on msg.sender, which controls the delegatecall target.
onlyOwner modifier gates rainCheckSetCollection on msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates rainCheckSetWhitelist on msg.sender.
The delegatecall in rainCheckStakeEth transfers control to external code that can re-enter rainCheckWithdraw before state settles.
The delegatecall in rainCheckStakeErc20 transfers control to external code that can re-enter rainCheckWithdraw.
The delegatecall in rainCheckWithdraw hands control to external code, enabling recursive re-entry into rainCheckWithdraw.
The delegatecall in rainCheckVoid transfers control to external code that can re-enter rainCheckWithdraw.
rainCheckSetDelegate writes the delegate address into the _delegate state variable.
rainCheckSetCollection writes the collection address into the _collection state variable.
rainCheckSetBaseURI writes the base URI string into the _BASEURI state variable.
rainCheckSetWhitelist writes the boolean value into the _whitelist mapping for the given key.
